2) When you choose a wireless network to share, your friends don't get to know your password! What is shared is an encrypted version of your password not your password itself.

The drawback I see for WiFi Sense as a concept is the following scenario:
A friend comes over and asks for your wireless network password to check their email on their new Windows 10 laptop (or Windows phone by the way). Now, since they have the profile of your wireless network saved on their laptop (or phone), they CAN decide to share that wireless network with their skype friends (including the ones you don't know) through WiFi Sense. This means that you can have complete strangers legitimately using your wireless connection if they are in range!

This scenario is simply avoided if you ask your friends not to share your wireless network (and they are trust-worthy friends).
